rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained (representation). The project checks the box only on a return that files Form 2441 (f2441.filing: care expenses or dependent care benefits); the second tests the provider count alone. A filer with neither does not file the form (i2441 p. 1, Purpose of Form, "you may be able to take the credit for child and dependent care expenses" and "you must use Form 2441 to figure the amount, if any, of the benefits you can exclude"), so there is no box to check; on every return that files it both test "more than three care providers" (i2441 p. 2, Line 1, "If you have more than three care providers, check the box above line 1"). No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; dependent.dc_count is a constant one per dependent, not an already-filtered qualifying-person count. The second omits the qualifying-person filter, contrary to f2441 (2025) p.1 line2 box and i2441 p.3 Line2. With four claimed dependents (one age5 and three age16, none disabled), only the age5 child qualifies: the project box is false, the second true. The saved evaluator witness is .transcription/f2441-flash-count-witness.json.

Ruling: scope; f2441 (2025) p. 2 lines 19/21 and i2441 pp. 2, 5 provide the separate-return spouse-income and $2500 exclusion branches. The entire married-filing-separately regime is refused by s3.mfs at f2441.line11 and s3.line11, so those branches cannot yield a supported completed return. The simpler nonjoint choice and $5000 ceiling apply only within the supported filing statuses. This ruling concerns completed returns, not an assertion that evaluating the individual line on an excluded MFS return produces the IRS amount.

Ruling: representation; f2441 (2025) p.2 line25 enters min(line20,line21) when line22 is zero and otherwise subtracts line24 with a zero floor. In the zero branch line24=min(line20,line21,line22)=0; both line20 and line21 are nonnegative, so subtract_floor0(min(line20,line21),0) equals the second branch value. The positive branch is already identical. No arithmetic or scope change.
